notes: All 31 grep hits in the decorators tree are accounted for; every row passes the file/line/expression gate. 44 tolerance predicates across 16 (file, function) pairs: 23 model rows, 5 param rows, 3 excluded rows (algo.rs:581 squared-distance-vs-squared-radius, degree 2 in length; algo.rs:687 scalar triple product via so_small2; contact_circle.rs:167 SPEC_GAP). The finding this packet most wants: one grep hit genuinely does not fit the model/param/excluded trichotomy -- contact_circle.rs:167 in next_point. There del is the solution of mat * (du, dv, z) = vec where the third matrix column is the unnormalized normal n = uder.cross(vder) (degree 2 in length), so del.z is dimensionally 1/length and scales as 1/k under a model rescale: it is neither a length (model) nor dimensionless (param), and either rewrite changes the debug assertion's behaviour under a real model_scale. Full analysis in QUESTION.md. Deliberate blind-spot searches (grep _TOLERANCE / TOLERANCE_ / bare TOLERANCE across truck-geometry, and written-out TOLERANCE * TOLERANCE) found nothing the inventory missed, so not_in_inventory is empty. The only other grep hits outside the inventory table are three doc-comment lines in decorators/mod.rs (219, 316, 318), which are prose under exclusion 4, not sites.
